note: Left-arm pre-moves before the model runs. If a key word appears in the command (case-insensitive), the left arm goes current -> via -> start, then the model starts. 6 values: shoulder_pan shoulder_lift elbow_flex wrist_flex wrist_roll gripper (LeRobot normalized). Measure with measure_pose.py, then set placeholder to false. Versions: pick one with eval_bi_api.py --start-version (default v4).

v4.note: No pre-move: the model starts from the normal start pose (no waypoint, no colour start pose).

v5.note: Left arm: current -> waypoint -> colour start pose, then the model.
